journey-action:end user customer:step:1.label: Initiates 'User Account' registration with personal PII; IAM Security Officer validates identity verification inputs against policy; outputs authenticated session token and user context enabling subsequent access.

attributes.narrative: Initiates 'User Account' registration with personal PII; IAM Security Officer validates identity verification inputs against policy; outputs authenticated session token and user context enabling subsequent access.

journey-action:end user customer:step:2.label: Submits 'Geolocation Request' via mobile GPS coordinates; system performs service area validation and delivery zone mapping against 'Merchant Inventory Stock' locations; outputs confirmed delivery pin and applicable service fee.

attributes.narrative: Submits 'Geolocation Request' via mobile GPS coordinates; system performs service area validation and delivery zone mapping against 'Merchant Inventory Stock' locations; outputs confirmed delivery pin and applicable service fee.

journey-action:end user customer:step:3.label: Selects products to create 'Cart Item' inputs including SKU and quantity; system executes real-time inventory availability checks and price calculation logic; outputs updated cart state with confirmed stock levels.

attributes.narrative: Selects products to create 'Cart Item' inputs including SKU and quantity; system executes real-time inventory availability checks and price calculation logic; outputs updated cart state with confirmed stock levels.

journey-action:end user customer:step:4.label: Requests a 'Delivery Slot' based on preferred time window; Logistics Dispatcher validates courier availability data and allocates slot; outputs assigned pickup and delivery timestamps.

attributes.narrative: Requests a 'Delivery Slot' based on preferred time window; Logistics Dispatcher validates courier availability data and allocates slot; outputs assigned pickup and delivery timestamps.

journey-action:end user customer:step:5.label: Finalizes transaction by submitting 'Order Header' and 'Order Line Item' details including payment method; 'Payment Transaction' component processes fund transfer and generates digital invoice; outputs unique Order ID and confirmed receipt.

attributes.narrative: Finalizes transaction by submitting 'Order Header' and 'Order Line Item' details including payment method; 'Payment Transaction' component processes fund transfer and generates digital invoice; outputs unique Order ID and confirmed receipt.

journey-action:end user customer:step:6.label: During transit, views 'Assigned Courier' details via app; Logistics Dispatcher executes route optimization and assigns active delivery task; outputs courier ID and real-time location updates.

attributes.narrative: During transit, views 'Assigned Courier' details via app; Logistics Dispatcher executes route optimization and assigns active delivery task; outputs courier ID and real-time location updates.

journey-action:end user customer:step:7.label: Upon arrival, provides 'Handover Receipt' input via digital signature and item count verification; Store Associate confirms quality check; outputs delivered status update and final payment capture confirmation.

attributes.narrative: Upon arrival, provides 'Handover Receipt' input via digital signature and item count verification; Store Associate confirms quality check; outputs delivered status update and final payment capture confirmation.

journey-action:end user customer:step:8.label: Participates in post-order lifecycle by managing 'Loyalty Points Ledger' for redemptions, requesting 'Refund Claim' with damage evidence, or initiating 'Cancellation Request' before handover; Finance & Billing Agent validates claims and adjusts balances.

attributes.narrative: Participates in post-order lifecycle by managing 'Loyalty Points Ledger' for redemptions, requesting 'Refund Claim' with damage evidence, or initiating 'Cancellation Request' before handover; Finance & Billing Agent validates claims and adjusts balances.

journey-action:store associate:step:1.label: Receives system-generated 'Pickup Manifest' input listing items to collect and store location coordinates; generates task list for store floor; outputs item verification log initiation.

attributes.narrative: Receives system-generated 'Pickup Manifest' input listing items to collect and store location coordinates; generates task list for store floor; outputs item verification log initiation.

journey-action:store associate:step:2.label: Scans 'Order Line Item' SKUs against physical shelf-space; validates item specifications and estimates weight; outputs collected items list and ready-for-pickup status flag.

attributes.narrative: Scans 'Order Line Item' SKUs against physical shelf-space; validates item specifications and estimates weight; outputs collected items list and ready-for-pickup status flag.

journey-action:store associate:step:3.label: Executes 'Merchant Inventory Stock' update by performing batch deduction and allocating shelf-space; outputs adjusted available quantity and updated stock status flags (e.g., In-Stock to Out-of-Stock).

attributes.narrative: Executes 'Merchant Inventory Stock' update by performing batch deduction and allocating shelf-space; outputs adjusted available quantity and updated stock status flags (e.g., In-Stock to Out-of-Stock).

journey-action:store associate:step:4.label: Validates 'Handover Receipt' input by comparing customer signature/digital confirmation against manifest item counts; performs quality check verification; outputs delivered status update and confirms final payment capture.

attributes.narrative: Validates 'Handover Receipt' input by comparing customer signature/digital confirmation against manifest item counts; performs quality check verification; outputs delivered status update and confirms final payment capture.

journey-action:logistics dispatcher:step.label: Processes 'Delivery Slot' input by analyzing customer requested time windows against real-time courier availability data; executes slot allocation and time-window enforcement logic; outputs assigned timestamps.

attributes.narrative: Processes 'Delivery Slot' input by analyzing customer requested time windows against real-time courier availability data; executes slot allocation and time-window enforcement logic; outputs assigned timestamps.

journey-action:logistics dispatcher:step.label: Receives 'Order Header' and 'Assigned Courier' inputs; runs route optimization algorithms to minimize fleet idle time; outputs active delivery task and assigned courier ID.

attributes.narrative: Receives 'Order Header' and 'Assigned Courier' inputs; runs route optimization algorithms to minimize fleet idle time; outputs active delivery task and assigned courier ID.

journey-action:logistics dispatcher:step.label: Monitors 'Assigned Courier' status and 'Real-time Driver Location Data'; modifies courier assignment mapping or re-assigns upon deviation; outputs updated route parameters and enforcement of time-window constraints.

attributes.narrative: Monitors 'Assigned Courier' status and 'Real-time Driver Location Data'; modifies courier assignment mapping or re-assigns upon deviation; outputs updated route parameters and enforcement of time-window constraints.

journey-action:logistics dispatcher:step.label: Validates 'Handover Receipt' completion from the courier perspective; removes inactive courier assignments from active queues; outputs cleared delivery task status.

attributes.narrative: Validates 'Handover Receipt' completion from the courier perspective; removes inactive courier assignments from active queues; outputs cleared delivery task status.

journey-action:merchant inventory manage.label: Reviews 'Merchant Inventory Stock' input from local store database; performs reconciliation of system stock with physical counts; outputs batch deduction logs and stock status flags.

attributes.narrative: Reviews 'Merchant Inventory Stock' input from local store database; performs reconciliation of system stock with physical counts; outputs batch deduction logs and stock status flags.

journey-action:merchant inventory manage.label: Manages 'Order Line Item' line-level inventory reservations; updates shelf-space allocation rules based on SKU demand; outputs adjusted available quantity and stock status flags.

attributes.narrative: Manages 'Order Line Item' line-level inventory reservations; updates shelf-space allocation rules based on SKU demand; outputs adjusted available quantity and stock status flags.

journey-action:merchant inventory manage.label: Handles 'Cancellation Request' triggers by executing inventory release logic; removes reserved stock holds upon validation; outputs released stock availability flags.

attributes.narrative: Handles 'Cancellation Request' triggers by executing inventory release logic; removes reserved stock holds upon validation; outputs released stock availability flags.

journey-action:merchant inventory manage.label: Creates 'Restock Orders' and 'New Inventory SKU Entries' to replenish shelf-space; removes expired or damaged batch records; outputs updated inventory levels and low-stock alerts.

attributes.narrative: Creates 'Restock Orders' and 'New Inventory SKU Entries' to replenish shelf-space; removes expired or damaged batch records; outputs updated inventory levels and low-stock alerts.

journey-action:iam security officer:step.label: Audits 'User Account' authentication credentials and 'Geolocation Request' authentications; enforces data privacy boundaries and validates identity verification steps; outputs security incident reports.

attributes.narrative: Audits 'User Account' authentication credentials and 'Geolocation Request' authentications; enforces data privacy boundaries and validates identity verification steps; outputs security incident reports.

journey-action:iam security officer:step.label: Reviews full audit trails of 'Create', 'Change', and 'Remove' actions across all actors; validates session token expiry logs; outputs compliance reports.

attributes.narrative: Reviews full audit trails of 'Create', 'Change', and 'Remove' actions across all actors; validates session token expiry logs; outputs compliance reports.

journey-action:iam security officer:step.label: Executes 'Force Account Lockout' or 'Reset Authentication Credentials' operations for compromised users; removes expired session tokens and invalid role assignments; outputs updated user account status.

attributes.narrative: Executes 'Force Account Lockout' or 'Reset Authentication Credentials' operations for compromised users; removes expired session tokens and invalid role assignments; outputs updated user account status.

journey-action:finance billing agent:ste.label: Processes 'Payment Transaction' input (Order total, tax, fees) via secure gateway; validates fund transfer and generates receipt; outputs paid status flag and digital invoice record.

attributes.narrative: Processes 'Payment Transaction' input (Order total, tax, fees) via secure gateway; validates fund transfer and generates receipt; outputs paid status flag and digital invoice record.

journey-action:finance billing agent:ste.label: Evaluates 'Refund Claim' input including reason and evidence; performs claim validation and partial/full fund reversal; outputs refund approval and adjusted account balance.

attributes.narrative: Evaluates 'Refund Claim' input including reason and evidence; performs claim validation and partial/full fund reversal; outputs refund approval and adjusted account balance.

journey-action:finance billing agent:ste.label: Manages 'Subscription Plan' input for recurring billing cycles; calculates fees and sets up automated billing; outputs active membership tier and priority delivery rights confirmation.

attributes.narrative: Manages 'Subscription Plan' input for recurring billing cycles; calculates fees and sets up automated billing; outputs active membership tier and priority delivery rights confirmation.

attributes.narrative: Executes 'Loyalty Points Ledger' updates by calculating point accrual and redemption validation; modifies order total based on points used; outputs updated points balance and discounted total.
